text: Leptomeningeal metastasis on the left inferior surface of the tentorium, now forming a mass 2 cm in diameter and 1.5 cm in thickness, previously punctate.
Massive edema extending to the brainstem and cerebellum associated with the left tentorial mass.
Cerebellar metastases that enhanced on the previous examination have disappeared or transformed into cystic focal areas.
No new metastatic foci in the posterior fossa.
New metastasis measuring 17 mm in diameter in the right putamen with extensive perilesional edema.
New metastasis measuring 5 mm in diameter in the head of the left caudate nucleus.
New metastasis measuring 1 cm in diameter in the left posterior parietal cortex.
New extra-axial metastasis in the left lateral occipital region, 17 mm in diameter, forming massive parenchymal edema.
New 5 mm extra-axial metastasis within the left Sylvian fissure.
Three new extra-axial metastases in the left frontal region.
Pituitary metastasis infiltrating the anterior lobe and stalk appears stable.
Bone metastases in the clivus, cervical vertebrae, and bilateral mandibular condyles.
No bone metastasis in the cranium.
